note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries. New wave-2 template distilled from a field workflow pattern; all records are fictional.

cases.onepager_bullet: Summarizes the territory's spend, revenue, share and recruiter coverage by metro in one view
cases.prompt: Give me a snapshot of my North Valley territory.

cases.onepager_bullet: Sizes the addressable market by service line for the territory or a single metro
cases.prompt: How big is the staffing market in Granite Ridge?

cases.onepager_bullet: Finds the service lines where demand outruns our share and recruiter coverage
cases.prompt: Where are our biggest coverage gaps?

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows who leads each metro and where we rank against the competition
cases.prompt: Who are we up against in each metro?

cases.onepager_bullet: Reads job-posting, wage and time-to-fill trends that shape the plan
cases.prompt: What labor market trends should I plan around?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the quarterly territory plan with opportunities, risks, recommendations and one priority action
must_include: no headcount, quota or account change was made

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
